name: I Want to XXXX HXX
source:
Teen tomboy ██████ collides with the effortlessly cool Edgar.
Both of them see something of themself reflected in the other.

Ashe encounters Cecilia years later, seeing just how much has changed.
And how much has held firm.
Will he repeat the same make he did as a teen girl? 

[from [url=https://superbiasedcat.itch.io/i-want-to-xxxx-hxx]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
假小子少女██████与潇洒酷炫的埃德加撞了个满怀。
两人都在对方身上看到了自己的一抹倒影。

多年之后，艾什与塞西莉亚再度重逢，亲眼见证了岁月究竟改变了多少事，
又有哪些东西始终未曾动摇。
他是否会重蹈当年自己还是少女时曾犯下的覆辙？
